**Audio Studio MCP 1.2.0 plays your sounds right in the chat.** In Claude Desktop and other clients with MCP Apps, results now appear as a player in the conversation. No breaking changes: clients without MCP Apps, such as Claude Code and Codex, get the same tools and the same text results as before. The license is unchanged (MIT). Update with `uv cache clean audio-studio-mcp`, then restart your client.

[🎧 Listen to samples](https://kanaworksai-hue.github.io/audio-studio-mcp/) · [English](https://github.com/kanaworksai-hue/audio-studio-mcp#readme) · [简体中文](https://github.com/kanaworksai-hue/audio-studio-mcp/blob/main/README.zh-CN.md) · [日本語](https://github.com/kanaworksai-hue/audio-studio-mcp/blob/main/README.ja.md) · [한국어](https://github.com/kanaworksai-hue/audio-studio-mcp/blob/main/README.ko.md) · [Português (Brasil)](https://github.com/kanaworksai-hue/audio-studio-mcp/blob/main/README.pt-BR.md) · [Español](https://github.com/kanaworksai-hue/audio-studio-mcp/blob/main/README.es.md)

## New: listen in the chat

`generate_audio`, `edit_audio` and `process_audio` results show up as a player in clients that support [MCP Apps](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/extensions/apps/overview) (Claude Desktop; the Codex app; VS Code with `chat.mcp.apps.enabled`; Cursor; Goose). You no longer have to open the files to hear them.

- **Waveform, play, pause and seek** for every version.
- **Compare at the same moment:** switch versions while one plays and the next continues from the same spot. Keys `1`–`9` pick a version; `0` plays the audio from before an edit.
- **Check loops:** **Loop** plays sample-accurately, and **Hear the seam** plays the end into the start.
- **Use this** tells the assistant which version you picked. **Export** saves it for a game or a video with the web UI's presets, and the export appears as its own playable line. **2 more versions** runs the same prompt with the next seeds.
- English, Japanese and Chinese, following the client's language, and its light or dark theme.
- The audio stays on your computer. The player gets a compressed preview (Ogg Vorbis, about 1 MB a minute) and a waveform from the server through a tool that only the player can call.
- `AUDIO_STUDIO_CHAT_PLAYER=off` turns the player off. `on` also shows it in clients that render MCP Apps without announcing support.

## Fixes

- **Windows, Claude Desktop:** if you moved the Hugging Face cache with a Windows environment variable (`HF_HOME`, `HF_HUB_CACHE` or `HUGGINGFACE_HUB_CACHE`), the server now finds the weights there. Claude Desktop starts servers without your environment variables, so the weights looked "not downloaded". When the client passes none of these variables, the server reads them from your Windows environment.

## Docs

- The README is now in six languages: English, 简体中文, 日本語, 한국어, Português (Brasil) and Español.
- A new "Listen in the chat" section in every language, with screenshots.

## Development

- Tests for the player: the UI resource and the tools' UI metadata, the preview tool (chunks, etag, output-folder-only reads), the unchanged tool list and results for clients without MCP Apps, and a browser test that runs the player in a sandboxed iframe under the default MCP Apps content security policy.
